summary: Iter45: RBAC (System Management ACL) + DD/MM/YYYY date display. Backend: 6/7 pytest pass (ACL round-trip incl _users/_mask/_userMask, SA-only write, default User create OK/delete 403 on ops+crm, role delete grant, per-user create deny, role client.c=false). Only failure: View (v) permission is NOT enforced on backend GET endpoints. Frontend: ACL matrix (A role 300 checkboxes, B user override selects, C masking) loads & saves with toast; Tax Invoice inv-date shows DD/MM/YYYY, accepts typed 05/11/2026, rejects 31/02, calendar icon present; rh-from/rh-to, Procurement creationDate, Bill form dates use DD/MM/YYYY. Masking as TEST_ User works (kpi-receivable hidden, 'TDS %' & 'TDS Kata' columns hidden). site.v=false hides '6. Project Management' from sidebar and /site shows 'Is department ki permission nahi hai'. BUG: OpsModule (Project Mgmt DPR/Indent, QC&Safety, P&M, CRM Booking/Tender/Agreement/Demand, HR labour/geo) date fields still native <input type=date> showing 10/25/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY); HR DynamicRows (Family DOB, Employment From/To) also native.

minor.issue: RBAC 'View' op never enforced server-side. With User.site.v=false, GET /api/ops/dpr still returns 200 with data. Frontend only blurs page (content still rendered/fetched behind overlay). Requirement said 'secured by frontend route guards + backend API validation'. Add _rbac(user, dept, 'v') to list/get endpoints (ops_list with OPS_DEPT[kind], crm list -> 'client', ACL_COLL_DEPT collections).

ui_bugs.issue: type='date' fields render native <input type=date> -> shows 10/25/2026 (browser locale MM/DD/YYYY), not DD/MM/YYYY. Affects /site DPR/Projects/Indent, /qc-safety, /plant, CRM Booking/Demand/Tender/Agreement/Abstract tabs, HR labour/geo modules. Use DateInput for f.type==='date'.
Generic row inputs use <input type={c.type}> so Family Members DOB and Employment History From/To are native date pickers (not DD/MM/YYYY). Use DateInput when c.type==='date'.

ui_bugs.component: pages/ReportsHub.jsx rh-month, LabourWages lbill-month, HR Start Month
ui_bugs.issue: type=month native inputs remain (show browser locale month format) - minor, consider MM/YYYY display.

integration_issues.issue: Permission-blocked screen is an overlay over the fully rendered page; underlying module still mounts and fetches data (backend allows). Prefer not rendering children when !can(dept,'v').

issues: Role list ACL_ROLES omits 'HR' role although backend register allows role 'HR' -> HR-role users cannot be configured in matrix (only defaults / per-user override).
User pick dropdown lists SuperAdmin account itself (overrides are no-op for SA).

action_items: Replace native date input in OpsModule.jsx Field with DateInput (DD/MM/YYYY) - visible MM/DD/YYYY on Project Mgmt DPR date
Use DateInput in HRManagement DynamicRows for type 'date' columns
Enforce 'v' permission on backend GET/list endpoints (ops, crm, legacy collections) to satisfy backend API validation requirement
Do not render module content behind the permission-blocked overlay
Add 'HR' role to ACL_ROLES in lib/acl.js (and to masking matrix)
critical_code_review_comments: _acl_ok reads settings doc from Mongo on every RBAC check (multiple per request for ops_upsert) - consider short TTL cache.
Masking is purely client-side (CSS/DOM hide); sensitive values still present in API responses and DOM - acceptable as 'UI masking' but document it.
col:Amount regex 'amount|total|value' is very broad and will hide many unrelated columns (e.g. 'Total Labour').
